cases.name: cancellation-during-pre-sink-path-stat
cases.rejected: cancelled while validating the first ready chunk
cases.explanation: The resolver aborts after currentPath guards and before its pending lstat completes. unchanged() returns without a final guard; capture invokes the blob sink, then notices cancellation.

cases.name: cancellation-during-final-path-stat
cases.expectedRejection: cancelled during the final source stat
cases.explanation: Final unchanged() lacks a guard after its awaited named lstat. An abort during that final check may return capture success.

scope: Finite deterministic lifecycle probes on authenticated exact review copies, with owned synthetic data. No production changes, full parity or security claim.
